findings.purpose: Provides default installation path for MetaTrader 5 terminal 64-bit binary.
findings.usage: Used in src/connector.py and src/credential_manager.py during terminal initialization and validation.
findings.risk_assessment: Low risk; environment fallback and GUI path configuration override exist if path is absent.
findings.remediation_plan: Externalize path into system environment variable 'MT5_TERMINAL_PATH' with config default.

findings.item: Default admin username 'QUANT_OPERATOR' with salt and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash of 'admin'
findings.purpose: Initializes baseline sovereign administrator account during first-time database creation.
findings.usage: Used in src/database.py and src/credential_manager.py for user authentication and admin privilege checks.
findings.risk_assessment: High risk if left with default password in live deployment; system provides forced password reset via CLI/GUI.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce mandatory password reset on first launch and accept initial credential via secure environment variable.

findings.item: Institutional Broker Plugin Magic Numbers 9100019 to 9100103

findings.risk_assessment: Low risk; deterministic IDs prevent MT5 magic number collisions across concurrent strategies.
findings.remediation_plan: Maintain central registry enumeration in src/config.py to prevent ID fragmentation.

findings.item: MT5 Terminal WebRequest and C-extension IPC socket connection protocol

findings.item: 15 Deterministic Risk Kernel Invariants (INV-001 to INV-015)
findings.purpose: Enforces hard boundaries for risk ceiling, daily drawdown (3.0%), position count (20), and spread spikes.
findings.usage: Evaluated prior to every order submission in src/eqats_planes.py and src/main.py.
findings.risk_assessment: Low risk; Level 1 safety kernel cannot be overridden by AI or strategy modules.
findings.remediation_plan: Keep risk invariants immutable in core microkernel.

findings.item: SQLite WAL journal mode with _INIT_DB_LOCK threading lock and 10,000ms busy timeout
findings.purpose: Prevents SQLite database lock contention and race conditions under multi-threaded parallel execution.
findings.usage: Used across all database read/write operations in src/database.py.
findings.risk_assessment: Low risk; thread-safe re-entrant lock and WAL journal mode guarantee transactional integrity.
